name: Music Discovery
description: Search for music inside Jellyfin and discover tracks, videos, and playlists.
overview: Adds a discovery layer to Jellyfin's music library, with optional Lidarr requests and streaming companions.

versions.changelog: - Add a popularity-provider status endpoint for dependent clients to gate rank-based features.
- Add top-ranked Deezer tracks endpoint for the artist-balanced Blind Test popularity mode.
- Add an authenticated top-ranked tracks API for Blind Test's Most popular mode.
- Add a resumable manual Deezer popularity index for local tracks, stored in the plugin data folder and exposed through user-scoped rank endpoints.

- Add a setting to hide plugin-generated discovery playlists and skip their background refresh.
- Keep requestable discovery albums in search results instead of adding them to local artist discographies.
- Hide discovery albums and songs that already exist in the Jellyfin music library.
- Replace Play with a centered, type-labeled Request action on non-video discovery cards; YouTube videos retain Play.
- Delay hiding empty native search rows until results have time to render, preventing section flicker.
- Keep the JellyMusicDiscovery and Play from YouTube search sections stable without flicker.
- Put YouTube music videos in a separate Play from YouTube search section after discovery results.
- Hide empty native search sections.
- Group discovery cards in a separate JellyMusicDiscovery section after local results.
- Target Jellyfin 12.1 on .NET 10.
- Intercept synthetic-video playback reports to prevent UserData foreign-key errors.
- Inject request controls into index.html only; leave JavaScript chunks untouched.
